svg.title: Final BT60 and MacBook Air keyboard layout
svg.desc: Two keyboards shown in base and Fn layers. BT60 and M3 MacBook Air share FR-OSS Arrows text input and Fn navigation and media shortcuts. Fn plus the bracket keys sends F14 and F15.
svg.text: BT60 V1 and M3 MacBook Air · shared FR-OSS Arrows input source
Fn / Raise · hold Fn to use the highlighted actions
Fn / Raise · hold Fn to use the highlighted actions
Right Option + Shift + O/K/L/M types ↑/←/↓/→ on both keyboards.
BT60: Fn + right Option opens Adjust; Bluetooth profile actions are inactive while BLE is disabled.
Print sends Print Screen (seen as F13 on macOS); it currently changes brightness on this Mac.
